edits.text: When the user refers to an item or 'my order' without specifying an order ID, use `get_user_details` to find the order(s) containing that item; if the item is in multiple orders, ask the user to clarify.
edits.reason: This addresses systematic failures where the agent failed to identify the correct order when only items were mentioned.

edits.text: When the user asks to exchange an item for the exact same model, explain that the system requires a different product option and use `get_product_details` to find and suggest available item IDs with different options of the same product.
edits.reason: This combines the need to explain policy constraints and provide alternatives when a user requests an identical exchange.

edits.text: When the user asks to exchange an item in an order that is pending, offer to modify the items in the order instead of telling them to wait until the order is delivered.
edits.reason: The agent failed to offer a valid modification for a pending order when the user used the word 'exchange'.

edits.text: Before calling `return_delivered_order_items`, verify that the user is able to send the items back; if they are not, do not proceed as the policy requires them to return the items.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent adheres to the policy's requirement that returns involve the user actually returning the items.
